title: puppi3 · Social (Postiz)
description: Postiz: scheduled, published and failed posts per network, channel health

panels.title: Published (selected range)
panels.description: One per channel (a post to 3 networks counts 3). Instagram counts what's on the account (posted by hand or not), from the bridge's Instagram numbers (every post on the account). SoundCloud counts uploads to the profile, from the bridge's SoundCloud numbers, Mixcloud uploads from its Mixcloud numbers (every track and upload).

targets.rawSql: SELECT count(*) AS postiz FROM "Post" p JOIN "Integration" i ON i.id = p."integrationId" WHERE p."deletedAt" IS NULL AND p."parentPostId" IS NULL AND p.state = 'PUBLISHED' AND $__timeFilter(p."publishDate") AND i."providerIdentifier" NOT IN ('instagram', 'instagram-standalone')

panels.title: Scheduled
panels.description: Posts scheduled in Ghost (each goes to the socials when Ghost publishes it), plus any scheduled straight in Postiz.

targets.rawSql: SELECT count(*) AS postiz FROM "Post" p WHERE p."deletedAt" IS NULL AND p."parentPostId" IS NULL AND p.state = 'QUEUE' AND p."publishDate" > now()

panels.title: Failed (selected range)
panels.description: Posts Postiz tried to publish in the selected range and couldn't. Details in Failed posts below.

targets.rawSql: SELECT count(*) FROM "Post" p WHERE p."deletedAt" IS NULL AND p."parentPostId" IS NULL AND p.state = 'ERROR' AND $__timeFilter(p."publishDate")

panels.title: Overdue in queue
panels.description: Should have gone out 15+ min ago but are still queued: the Postiz workers may be stuck

targets.rawSql: SELECT count(*) FROM "Post" p WHERE p."deletedAt" IS NULL AND p."parentPostId" IS NULL AND p.state = 'QUEUE' AND p."publishDate" < now() - interval '15 minutes'

panels.title: Channels connected
panels.description: Social accounts connected in Postiz and not disabled.

targets.rawSql: SELECT count(*) FROM "Integration" i WHERE i."deletedAt" IS NULL AND NOT i.disabled

panels.title: Channels needing attention
panels.description: Disabled, or needs re-login in Postiz

targets.rawSql: SELECT count(*) FROM "Integration" i WHERE i."deletedAt" IS NULL AND (i."refreshNeeded" OR i."inBetweenSteps" OR i.disabled)

panels.title: Posts published per day by network
panels.description: Instagram: posts on the account (by hand or not), from the bridge's Instagram numbers (every post on the account). SoundCloud and Mixcloud: uploads to the profiles, from the bridge's SoundCloud and Mixcloud numbers.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(p."publishDate", '1d'), initcap(replace(replace(i."providerIdentifier", '-standalone', ''), '-', ' ')) AS metric, count(*) AS posts
FROM "Post" p JOIN "Integration" i ON i.id = p."integrationId"
WHERE p."deletedAt" IS NULL AND p."parentPostId" IS NULL AND p.state = 'PUBLISHED' AND $__timeFilter(p."publishDate") AND i."providerIdentifier" NOT IN ('instagram', 'instagram-standalone')
GROUP BY 1, 2
ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Published by network (selected range)
panels.description: Instagram: posts on the account (by hand or not), from the bridge's Instagram numbers. SoundCloud and Mixcloud: uploads to the profiles.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT initcap(replace(replace(i."providerIdentifier", '-standalone', ''), '-', ' ')) AS network, count(*) AS posts
FROM "Post" p JOIN "Integration" i ON i.id = p."integrationId"
WHERE p."deletedAt" IS NULL AND p."parentPostId" IS NULL AND p.state = 'PUBLISHED' AND $__timeFilter(p."publishDate") AND i."providerIdentifier" NOT IN ('instagram', 'instagram-standalone')
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC

panels.title: Up next
panels.description: Ghost's scheduled posts, soonest first, and where each will go when Ghost publishes it, worked out by the bridge (GET /upnext.json) from the post's tags, its media and the connected Postiz channels, by the same rules it posts with: "Posts itself to" goes out at once; "You post in the app" gets a Postiz draft and an ntfy reminder (Instagram/TikTok without sound, unless #autopost; #bigdrop's link Story); "Left out" won't get it. Photos that can't be made to fit only show at publish time: the Social preview runs it all. Posts scheduled straight in Postiz are listed too. Edit the post in Ghost to change any of it.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT p."publishDate" AS "Scheduled for", left(regexp_replace(p.content, '<[^>]+>', '', 'g'), 140) AS "Post",
       initcap(replace(replace(i."providerIdentifier", '-standalone', ''), '-', ' ')) || ' (' || i.name || ')' AS "Posts itself to",
       '' AS "You post in the app", '' AS "Left out", '' AS "Media", 'Scheduled in Postiz' AS "Notes",
       '' AS "Social preview", '' AS preview
FROM "Post" p JOIN "Integration" i ON i.id = p."integrationId"
WHERE p."deletedAt" IS NULL AND p."parentPostId" IS NULL AND p.state = 'QUEUE' AND p."publishDate" > now()
ORDER BY p."publishDate"
LIMIT 25

value.title: The post's Social preview: each channel's caption and photos (sign in to Ghost first)

panels.title: Recently published
panels.description: Instagram, YouTube, SoundCloud, Mixcloud, Bluesky, Threads and TikTok rows are the accounts' own posts, videos and uploads (made in the app or through Postiz), from the bridge's numbers for each (every post on the account); the rest (X, LinkedIn…) are Postiz's. vs your usual: each post against your other posts on that network, on what the network ranks posts by (hover for why); vs industry: against the published average for that network (hover for the numbers; the analytics guide explains both). Click a row for that post up close (the Post dashboard); Postiz's rows have no numbers, as the bridge doesn't collect those networks.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT p."publishDate" AS "Published", initcap(replace(replace(i."providerIdentifier", '-standalone', ''), '-', ' ')) AS "Network", i.name AS "Account",
       left(regexp_replace(p.content, '<[^>]+>', '', 'g'), 120) AS "Post", p."releaseURL" AS "Link",
       '' AS ref, (extract(epoch FROM p."publishDate") * 1000)::bigint::text AS posted_ms,
       '' AS "vs your usual", '' AS perf_tip, '' AS "vs industry", '' AS industry_tip
FROM "Post" p JOIN "Integration" i ON i.id = p."integrationId"
WHERE p."deletedAt" IS NULL AND p."parentPostId" IS NULL AND p.state = 'PUBLISHED' AND i."providerIdentifier" NOT IN ('instagram', 'instagram-standalone', 'youtube', 'bluesky', 'threads', 'tiktok', 'tiktok-business')
ORDER BY p."publishDate" DESC
LIMIT 25

links.title: This post up close: its numbers per day and what it did for the site

properties.value: Against the published average for this network (Instagram per person reached, TikTok and YouTube per view, newsletters' click rate). Mostly big brand accounts, so a second opinion. Hover for the numbers.

panels.title: Failed posts
panels.description: Posts Postiz couldn't publish, with the error it got.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT p."publishDate" AS "When", initcap(replace(replace(i."providerIdentifier", '-standalone', ''), '-', ' ')) AS "Network", i.name AS "Account",
       left(regexp_replace(p.content, '<[^>]+>', '', 'g'), 80) AS "Post", left(coalesce(p.error, ''), 200) AS "Error"
FROM "Post" p JOIN "Integration" i ON i.id = p."integrationId"
WHERE p."deletedAt" IS NULL AND p."parentPostId" IS NULL AND p.state = 'ERROR'
ORDER BY p."publishDate" DESC
LIMIT 25

panels.title: Channels
panels.description: Each social account in Postiz and whether it needs reconnecting.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT initcap(replace(replace(i."providerIdentifier", '-standalone', ''), '-', ' ')) AS "Network", i.name AS "Account",
       CASE WHEN i.disabled THEN 'Disabled' WHEN i."refreshNeeded" OR i."inBetweenSteps" THEN 'Reconnect needed' ELSE 'OK' END AS "Status",
       i."createdAt" AS "Connected"
FROM "Integration" i
WHERE i."deletedAt" IS NULL
ORDER BY 1, 2

panels.title: Drafts to post in the app

options.content: Drafts the bridge handed you (tag "Post in app"): Instagram and TikTok posts you share by hand from its notifications. Each network's own numbers are on [Platforms](/d/puppi3-platforms).

panels.title: Drafts to post in the app
panels.description: Postiz drafts the bridge tagged "Post in app" (Instagram/TikTok posts you share by hand), dated in the selected range

targets.rawSql:
SELECT count(*) FROM "Post" p JOIN "Integration" i ON i.id = p."integrationId"
WHERE p."deletedAt" IS NULL AND p."parentPostId" IS NULL AND p.state = 'DRAFT' AND $__timeFilter(p."publishDate")
  AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "TagsPosts" tp JOIN "Tags" t ON t.id = tp."tagId" WHERE tp."postId" = p.id AND t.name = 'Post in app' AND t."deletedAt" IS NULL)

panels.title: Drafts handed to you (post in the app)
panels.description: Newest first. Post = the caption without formatting; a Story has none.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT p."publishDate" AS "Date", initcap(replace(replace(i."providerIdentifier", '-standalone', ''), '-', ' ')) AS "Network", i.name AS "Account",
       coalesce(nullif(left(regexp_replace(p.content, '<[^>]+>', '', 'g'), 120), ''), 'Story') AS "Post"
FROM "Post" p JOIN "Integration" i ON i.id = p."integrationId"
WHERE p."deletedAt" IS NULL AND p."parentPostId" IS NULL AND p.state = 'DRAFT' AND $__timeFilter(p."publishDate")
  AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "TagsPosts" tp JOIN "Tags" t ON t.id = tp."tagId" WHERE tp."postId" = p.id AND t.name = 'Post in app' AND t."deletedAt" IS NULL)
ORDER BY p."publishDate" DESC
LIMIT 50

panels.title: Drafts by network
panels.description: Drafts waiting for you to post in the app, per network.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT initcap(replace(replace(i."providerIdentifier", '-standalone', ''), '-', ' ')) AS "Network", count(*) AS "Drafts"
FROM "Post" p JOIN "Integration" i ON i.id = p."integrationId"
WHERE p."deletedAt" IS NULL AND p."parentPostId" IS NULL AND p.state = 'DRAFT' AND $__timeFilter(p."publishDate")
  AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "TagsPosts" tp JOIN "Tags" t ON t.id = tp."tagId" WHERE tp."postId" = p.id AND t.name = 'Post in app' AND t."deletedAt" IS NULL)
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 2 DESC
